Defines AG Grid quartz theme styles, icons, layout, colors, and interaction states.

# Purpose
This stylesheet defines the visual system for AG Grid `quartz` themes, including `ag-theme-quartz`, `ag-theme-quartz-dark`, and `ag-theme-quartz-auto-dark`. It sets CSS custom properties and style rules for layout, spacing, padding, margins, cursor behavior, opacity, and color values across grid parts such as headers, rows, cells, filter panels, column select controls, search inputs, checkboxes, radio buttons, detail rows, menus, dialogs, tool panels, and chart settings. The file also maps many `ag-icon-*` classes to font codes and image slots, and it includes embedded SVG data for the search icon. At the end, the `._grid_f48q6_1` rule maps application container colors to AG Grid theme variables so the grid matches the host UI.
